ui.role: Low-level reusable React component library with Radix UI, Lexical editor, and utility exports

web-core.role: Shared React + TypeScript library for frontend features, hooks, and project-specific components used by both local and remote apps

local-web.role: Tauri-based local desktop application entrypoint for Vibe

remote-web.role: Cloud/remote deployment web application entrypoint for Vibe

shared.role: Generated TypeScript types and schemas from Rust definitions, plus JWT utilities; used by all packages

answer.direction: Dependencies flow upward from foundation libraries (ui, shared) → shared library (web-core) → application entrypoints (local-web, remote-web); both apps are peers that reuse web-core.

grade.judge_notes: Missing the '@/*' path alias detail that explains how app shells consume web-core sources; direction statement is unclear and confusingly phrases dependencies as flowing from foundations to apps (backwards), and incorrectly labels web-core as 'shared library'.
